source: TSY: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, re-fetched direct by this event's own initial research 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,182 bytes) — the 2027 table's April row reads '30 - final' in the column headed 'Annual: Foreign portfolio holdings of U.S. securities at end-June of previous year', and the page's own rule states 'the final report is released on the last business day of April' under 'All data releases occur at 4 p.m. Washington, D.C. time'. Promoted estimate -> confirmed on the same standard as the sibling tic-annual-survey-prelim-2027-02-26 and mts-october-2026-11-12: one named Treasury primary plus independent mechanical corroboration. The corroboration is recomputed from 5 U.S.C. 6103 rather than a holiday list — the last business day of April 2027 is Friday 2027-04-30, and April carries no federal holiday at all, so the annual rule needs no holiday handling in this month. The estimate ground the proposal cited was this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep; that is cleared here by this event's own session re-fetching the page. notes: Canonical file written by this event's never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09) after reading the one proposal that created it (from-tic-monthly-2027-02-18, now shadowed). Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds: 16:00 ET publication after the equity cash close, an end-June 2026 reference date that is ten months stale at print, and no house playbook keyed to a macro release. THREE THINGS THIS SESSION MEASURED THAT CHANGE HOW THE ENTRY SHOULD BE READ. (1) This is the half of the pair that has actually slipped: over the modern Feb/Apr regime (2008-2026) the final landed on the computed last business day of April in 18 of 19 years, the exception being the End-June 2015 report published 2016-05-31 instead of 2016-04-29 — a 32-day slip — while the preliminary's realized record over the same span is 19 of 19. Base rate 5.3% vs 0%. (2) It is the survey's only durable artefact: Treasury's own SHL reports webpage lists one report PDF and one press-release date per survey year back to 2004, and every one of those dates is the April/May final — not one is a February preliminary, and four more direct probes for a preliminary PDF returned 404 on top of the eight the sibling recorded. (3) Its numbers are permanent: totals published in five independent report vintages (shla2010r April 2011, shla2011r, shl2015r, shla2017r, shl2019r April 2020) match the current shlhistdat.csv panel for every overlapping June to the last million. What moves after publication is the country allocation (Treasury documents an $83bn Hong Kong -> Taiwan shift in the 2012 long-term agency data) and shares-of-outstanding (2024 restated from '21 percent' to 20.5 percent), never the totals. THE CORRIDOR IS THE MOST CONTAMINATED IN THIS SERIES: fomc-2027-04-28 (high, est) and boj-decision-2027-04-28 (medium, est) land two days before, and because 2027-04-30 is a Friday the NEXT session is Monday 2027-05-03, Treasury's own marketable-borrowing-estimates release, with the quarterly refunding announcement on Wednesday 2027-05-05.
